tickets.title: Admin auth (single-admin login + middleware)
acceptanceCriteria: ADMIN_PASSWORD from env, login page at /admin/login
Middleware redirects unauthenticated /admin/* visits to login
Logout clears session
Wrong password shows error

tickets.title: Admin layout + dashboard stats page
acceptanceCriteria: /admin shell with nav: Dashboard, Products, Orders, Builds
Revenue from paid orders, order counts by status, stock alerts, recent orders
Stock alerts link to product edit page

tickets.title: Product CRUD (list, create, edit, retire)
acceptanceCriteria: Table with search/filter by category and stock status
Per-category structured spec fields driven by catalog.ts
Price stored as integer cents
Generated SVG placeholder image with color picker
Retire sets out_of_stock; retired products leave shop listing

tickets.title: Order management (list, detail, status changes)
acceptanceCriteria: Orders list with publicId, customer, total, status, date
Detail view with items snapshot
Admin can change order status; changes persist and reflect immediately

tickets.title: Builds moderation (list, preview, delete)
acceptanceCriteria: Saved-builds list with owner, name, date
Preview link to public build page
Delete with confirmation; public page then 404s gracefully

tickets.title: Discounts & promotions (codes, checkout integration, admin UI)
acceptanceCriteria: Discount codes with type percent or fixed amount, optional expiry and usage limit
Checkout applies valid code and recalculates totals
Invalid/expired codes rejected with clear error
Admin can create, list, and deactivate codes
Professional, polished UI consistent with the site design
